premise: After my father died, my sister forged a codicil cutting me out of the family bowling alley I’d managed for 24 years while she lived out of state, and she sold the land and equipment for $780,000, mailing me a $4,800 'shoe rental' check; I discovered a voice memo on Dad’s old flip phone in which he told her the real will in the safe deposit box still left me 60% and warned her not to touch it. I contested probate, reclaimed the alley, and now run 'Split of Deceit Lanes,' where she oils lanes in a shirt that says 'Gutter of Lies' and every score sheet prints her probate-fraud docket.
